name: member-statement
title: DRAFT member points statement

sections.title: Point lots
sections.sql: select reference,points,remaining,earned_on,expires_on from lot_balances where member_id=$1 order by expires_on

sections.title: Reward requests
sections.sql: select reference,points,status,due_on from redemptions where member_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Evidence
sections.sql: select evidence,created_at,updated_at from redemptions where id=$1
